change: Replace per-frame ordinary I420 RAM allocation/free with a private reference-counted output pool; each delivered frame exclusively owns its allocation until cedar_frame_free.

architecture.references: One decoder owner plus one reference per outstanding frame; cached blocks hold no reference. Closing marks pool closed and frees cached blocks; outstanding frames release their blocks and final pool reference later.
architecture.threading: Decoder operations including pull/flush/close remain externally serialized. Independent frame frees can run concurrently with each other and decoder close.
architecture.memory_scope: Ordinary CPU RAM only, no DMA allocation/import/map lifetime change. Max two idle1080p I420 blocks are approximately6.22MB; caller-retained outstanding frames are separately owned and not counted in idle limit.
architecture.ABI: cedar_frame field types/order and all exported prototypes unchanged; release through cedar_frame_free from the matching backend library, not free(data).
